notes: Repeatable optional Cliffside free time only; none of these events replace the authored alley/Joren fight. Victories award one roll of gold and EXP, no rewards for defeat/retreat. Each is a non-lethal roadside intervention.

asmodeus.title: The Toll Nobody Authorized
asmodeus.intro: Two thugs block a cobbled street and claim to collect a toll. Asmodeus does not look impressed.

asmodeus.title: Roadside Shortcuts
asmodeus.intro: A pair of bandits mistake a lone traveler for easy money. Asmodeus almost laughs.

asmodeus.title: Wagon Held Hostage
asmodeus.intro: Highwaymen try to extort a supply cart on the town road. The driver asks for help.

asmodeus.title: The Outlaw Barricade
asmodeus.intro: A veteran outlaw and an armored bruiser have commandeered a back alley. They're a tougher challenge.

haniel.title: A Silent Warning
haniel.intro: Haniel spots a cutpurse cornering someone by a stairway. She raises her angelic bow without speaking.

haniel.title: Market Street Extortion
haniel.intro: Two thugs demand a vendor's earnings. Haniel steps between them and the trembling shopkeeper.

haniel.title: The Missing Courier
haniel.intro: A courier's dropped satchel leads Haniel to two highwaymen hiding outside the town walls.

haniel.title: The Lantern Patrol
haniel.intro: Lanterns light an uneasy back lane. A veteran brigand and heavy outlaw refuse Haniel's quiet warning.
